meta.name: component
meta.description: Create UI component / widget / reusable piece. Triggers "create component", "new component", "add component", or naming a component (Button, Header, Card).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建可复用的UI组件和部件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要创建新的UI组件或修改现有组件。
copy.tagline_en: Create reusable UI components and widgets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to create or modify UI components.

howto.what: 装好后，当你说出创建组件的指令时，Claude会先检测项目类型（Next.js或React Router），然后自动生成符合Darkroom约定的React组件文件，包括组件代码、CSS模块和正确的导入路径。
howto.when: 当你提到“创建组件”、“新组件”、“添加组件”，或者直接说出组件名称（如Button、Header）时触发。也可以使用参数指定组件名和--client标志（仅Next.js）强制创建客户端组件。

say.note: 强制创建客户端组件（仅Next.js）

howto.what_en: After installation, when you instruct to create a component, Claude first detects the project stack (Next.js or React Router), then automatically generates React component files following Darkroom conventions, including component code, CSS module, and correct import paths.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'create component', 'new component', 'add component', or name a component (e.g., Button, Header). Also when you provide a component name argument and optionally --client flag (Next.js only) to force client component.

say_en.note: Claude detects stack and generates files.
